intents.canonical_question: How do I edit my profile?

intents.answer_text: Open Profile in the sidebar → Settings for account, security, notifications, and subscription. Changes apply across Rovvy on every device you're signed into.
Your profile keeps posts and trip moments in one place. Open Profile → Posts or Memories to revisit what your group captured.
Plan is Rovvy's booking and routing hub. Open Plan in the sidebar to search Flights, Hotels, Routes, and Buses — compare options next to your group context.
Open Plan → Flights, enter origin, destination, and dates, then compare options. You can keep planning beside your group trip context.
Open Plan → Hotels, set your destination and dates, then browse stays. Save favorites and share picks with your group.
Open Plan → Routes (or use Live) to compare driving and related route options between places. On Live you can also set a destination and preview the path on the map.
Open Plan → Buses to browse bus options for your corridor. Buses coverage is expanding — use Live for local last-mile walking when needed.
Explore is your discovery layer — trending destinations, events, activities, and weather cues. Filter by mood, save places with the heart icon, and pull them into a trip.
Open Live for the fullscreen map: GPS, pins, routes, and Solo Live navigation. It's built for on-the-road coordination — drop a pin, preview a route, and ask Wayra about the place.
Solo Live turns on turn-by-turn navigation on the map — pick a destination, tap Set destination, then Start Solo Live to follow the route with GPS.
